units: metres, radians, quaternion wxyz; environment-relative poses

generation.order_frame: environment frame, descending Y (+Y/robot left to -Y/robot right); not camera left/right

reasoning.y_spacing: 0.40 m exceeds largest scaled half-width pair (~0.16+0.13), 30 mm combined jitter and 60 mm planar access gap; filter checks actual rotated footprints
reasoning.x_anchors: Near calibrated object X; plate +30 mm and shelf +10 mm give table-edge margin after yaw/jitter
reasoning.approach_gap: 60 mm planar corridor proxy: 106 mm expert full-jaw opening / 2 + 7 mm margin; NOT a swept arm/hand clearance proof
reasoning.table: 20 mm erosion of measured frame envelope is only a planning bound until actual support-surface evidence is supplied
reasoning.yaw: Pilot verified +/-2 degrees; +/-5 degrees is a new candidate range, not runtime validated
reasoning.height: Original cfg root Z and scale unchanged; normal physical settling is unchanged
